title: Jonah and the Radiators
author: Dominic Eastwick
blurb: Kestrel Iversen, a bridge inspector measuring the marriage in expansion joints, has spent five years practicing the art of almost saying it. Then a song on the radio is one that was written and never recorded — and they are pulled straight into the middle of it. Now they must return to the place where the story went wrong, and time is already running out.
style: warm, character-driven storytelling with gentle humor
